stem: The monthly rent, in rupees, of an apartment in Karachi, Pakistan, \(t\) years after 2024 is modeled by \(R(t) = 45{,}000(1.08)^{t}\). According to the model, by what percent is the monthly rent in 2027 greater than the monthly rent in 2024? (Round to the nearest percent.)
solution: With a calculator, \((1.08)^{3} \approx 1.2597\), so the rent in 2027 is about \(126\%\) of the rent in 2024.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This adds \(8\%\) three times. Each year's \(8\%\) is taken from a larger rent, so the total increase, \((1.08)^{3} - 1\), is more than \(24\%\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. \(8\%\) is the increase for a single year. From 2024 to 2027 the rent increases three times.
explanation.C: Correct. \((1.08)^{3} \approx 1.26\), so the rent is about \(26\%\) greater after 3 years.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The rent in 2027 is about \(126\%\) of the rent in 2024, which is an increase of about \(26\%\), not \(126\%\).

verify:
r = Rational('1.08')**3 - 1
assert abs(N(r) - 0.26) < 0.005
assert abs(value(choices[answer]) - r) < 0.005
assert all(abs(value(choices[k]) - r) > 0.01 for k in choices if k != answer)
